changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Separate schema-only single-model admission from ordinary plan publication; retain model claims and history.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate DROP CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_materialization_context; ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_materialization_context CHECK ( origin IN ('SINGLE_MODEL_INTENT', 'BATCH_WORKBENCH', 'SCHEMA_ONLY_INTENT') AND ( ( execution_target_key IS NULL AND adapter IS NULL AND profile_key IS NULL AND target_name IS NULL ) OR ( btrim(execution_target_key) <> '' AND execution_target_key = btrim(execution_target_key) AND btrim(adapter) <> '' AND adapter = btrim(adapter) AND btrim(profile_key) <> '' AND profile_key = btrim(profile_key) AND btrim(target_name) <> '' AND target_name = btrim(target_name) ) ) ); DROP INDEX uk_model_release_candidate_active_plan; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_model_release_candidate_active_plan ON modeling_model_release_candidate (tenant_id, plan_id) WHERE origin <> 'SCHEMA_ONLY_INTENT' AND status NOT IN ('REJECTED','ROLLED_BACK','STALE','CANCELLED','PUBLISHED');
